subject.title: feat: add signed marketplace feed config

question: Should OpenClaw expose signed marketplace feed trust-anchor config before signed refresh enforcement lands, with selected signed profiles currently failing closed by throwing?
rationale: The code is a bounded implementation slice, but the permanent trust model and staged fail-closed operator behavior are security/product choices that automated review cannot own.

options.title: Accept staged signed config after proof refresh
options.body: Require current-head proof for the throwing no-fetch path plus maintainer/security review, then land this config slice in the intended trust-series order.

options.title: Land only with enforcement
options.body: Hold this PR until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98338 is ready so config, envelope verification, snapshot trust, and runtime behavior are reviewed together.

options.title: Defer signed feed config
options.body: Decline or defer this surface if maintainers do not want local signed-feed trust anchors exposed before a complete marketplace trust workflow exists.

recommendation.title: Accept staged signed config after proof refresh
recommendation.body: Require current-head proof for the throwing no-fetch path plus maintainer/security review, then land this config slice in the intended trust-series order.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current marketplace feed/config stack and are best positioned to explain the staged trust model for maintainer approval.
